Elaine (CSE): Quick weekly check — rollforward to rg-2.1 started 72h ago. Model mix is shifting to rg-2.1 (~48% of calls), rg-1.9 still ~50%, others ~2%. Notable: a fallback rate increase for rg-2.1 canary to 8.9% (baseline 2.2%). Latency p95 +12ms on average. Sharing quick snapshot below.

Ravi (CSM): Can you paste the top-line metrics so I can brief BetaCo tomorrow? :eyes:

Elaine (CSE): Sure — quick paste from the observability query: ```
period: last 72h
model_mix: rg-2.1: 48.1%, rg-1.9: 49.6%, other: 2.3%
fallback_rate_by_model: rg-2.1: 8.9%, rg-1.9: 1.8%
errors_5xx: +0.6% abs (spike correlated with fallback bursts)
latency_p95_delta: rg-2.1 +12ms vs rg-1.9
avg_token_cost_delta: +9% for rg-2.1 (due to longer decode paths)
```

Jules (Reliability): Is the fallback behavior coming from OOMs, timeouts, or explicit runtime policy? Any stack traces?

Elaine (CSE): Quick triage: logs show intermittent KV cache warm misses and one instance of a CUDA OOM on the dedicated pool during heavy bunching at ~03:10 UTC. Most fallbacks flagged as "capacity_fallback" in the runtime logs.

deploy-bot: Deploy rg-2.1 canary -> 2026-03-19T22:11:05Z by ci/cd (weight 10% -> 25%) :rocket:

Tom (SRE): Thanks — leaning towards cache coldstart + batching mismatch. When can we capture a heap/profile from an affected instance? I can attach an ephemeral trace.

Priya (Onboarding): BetaCo reported a UI-level fallback yesterday that surfaced as a generic "Try again" message. They lost a small number of completions (~0.4% of session completions). They asked if we can temporarily pin them to rg-1.9.

Ravi (CSM): We should offer to pin BetaCo for the renewal cohort — low effort and keeps them happy. Elaine, can you confirm impact window and ETA for rollback/pin?

Elaine (CSE): I can request a per-customer routing override. ETA ~30m for a pin. For cluster-level mitigation: propose reducing canary weight to 10% and turn on additional KV prewarm for rg-2.1 in the dedicated pool.

Jules (Reliability): Agreed. Immediate mitigations: 1) reduce canary to 10% (Ops), 2) enable aggressive KV prewarm for 24h (Runtime), 3) add a transient circuit-breaker for repeated fallbacks (SRE). These should cut fallback rate to <2.5% in the short term.

Tom (SRE): I'll provision the trace and follow up with the trace IDs here when available. Also will check instance OOM frequency against GPU driver logs.

Priya (Onboarding): I'll message BetaCo with a short note offering a temporary pin and an ETA. Will attach the known mitigations so they have context.

Ravi (CSM): Sound plan. Heads-up for renewal call: small teach on model differences and mention we'll monitor quality regressions automatically.

Elaine (CSE): Action items: 
- ops: reduce canary weight to 10% (Tom) — due 1798002000
- runtime: enable KV prewarm for rg-2.1 on dedicated pools (Jules) — due 1798003000
- eng: investigate decode path cost increase and patch if needed (eng-oncall) — due 1798080000
- cs: pin BetaCo to rg-1.9 on request (Elaine) — ETA 30m

Elaine (CSE): I'll post a follow-up in ~2h with updated metrics. Thanks team :thumbsup:
